## Claims

| Claim | Concept | Status |
|---|---|---|
| A lever balances when force × arm is equal on both sides | leva | standard, verified by the live calculation |
| Without friction, the force up a ramp is weight × height ÷ length | piano | standard (ideal ramp) |
| A fixed pulley changes the direction of the force, not its size; a movable pulley halves it and needs twice the rope | carrucola | standard (ideal pulley, no weight) |
